status: Draft queries awaiting user review; no relevance labels assigned.
scope: Saved Business & Money catalog; proposed learning-goal scenarios.

queries.query: I want to know what is needed to start a online business, given that i  have a finance background
queries.success_criterion: Practical guidance on starting an online business; finance experience is context, not a request for investment advice.

queries.query: I am a software engineer and want to validate a business idea before spending months building a product.
queries.success_criterion: Customer discovery and testing demand before product development.

queries.query: I work full time as a teacher and want to start a small side business without quitting my job.
queries.success_criterion: Practical side-business planning with limited time and low financial risk.

queries.query: I am a designer and want to turn my freelance work into a sustainable consulting business.
queries.success_criterion: Finding clients, defining services, pricing, and running a small service business, biographies of other designers that started similar businesses.

queries.query: I own a small physical shop and want to begin selling my products online.
queries.success_criterion: Moving a retail business into e-commerce, including fulfillment and online customer acquisition.

queries.query: I have launched an online store and want to attract my first customers with a small marketing budget.
queries.success_criterion: Practical customer acquisition for a new online store with limited resources. Success stories of companies that started with limited budgets.

queries.query: I am a technical founder and need to learn how to sell software to other businesses.
queries.success_criterion: Business-to-business sales (B2B), prospecting, conversations, and closing customers. Case studies of successful technical founders in B2B sales.

queries.query: I am a freelancer and want to price my services confidently instead of competing only on low prices.
queries.success_criterion: Service pricing, value communication, and negotiating fees. Freelance stories.

queries.background: Small business owner with repeat customers
queries.query: I run a small business and want to improve customer retention rather than relying on constant advertising.
queries.success_criterion: Understanding customer loyalty, service, and repeat purchases.

queries.query: I understand product design but want to learn how to position a new product and communicate why customers should choose it.
queries.success_criterion: Positioning, differentiation, and clear customer-focused messaging.

queries.query: I have just become a manager and need to learn how to lead people, give feedback, and delegate.
queries.success_criterion: Accessible first-manager guidance with practical people-management tools. Leadership books and different management styles.

queries.query: I manage a remote team and want to improve communication and accountability without micromanaging.
queries.success_criterion: Distributed-team coordination, expectations, trust, and accountability. How Remote work works and how to manage remote teams.

queries.query: I manage an experienced team but need help having difficult conversations about poor performance.
queries.success_criterion: Constructive feedback and performance conversations with concrete techniques. Leading through inspiring.

queries.query: My small company is growing and I need to build processes so every decision does not depend on me.
queries.success_criterion: Delegation, operating systems, and repeatable processes for a growing company. Similar stories of founders who successfully scaled their companies.

queries.query: I lead a department and need to help employees adopt a major change in how we work.
queries.success_criterion: Organizational change, employee engagement, and implementation.

queries.query: I started a small business and want to understand income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow.
queries.success_criterion: Beginner-friendly interpretation of financial statements for running a business.

queries.background: Profitable business owner with cash shortages
queries.query: My business reports a profit but often runs short of cash; I want to understand and improve working capital.
queries.success_criterion: Cash-flow management and working capital rather than profit alone.

queries.query: I have my first full-time job and want to build a long-term saving and investing plan without trading stocks every day.
queries.success_criterion: Accessible personal finance and long-term investing principles. 101 guides to investing and saving for beginners.

queries.query: I have a finance background and want to learn how to value a business using its financial statements.
queries.success_criterion: Business valuation methods and interpretation suited to someone with finance knowledge.

queries.query: I am preparing to raise money for my startup and want to understand funding options, dilution, and investor expectations.
queries.success_criterion: Startup financing, equity, fundraising mechanics, and investor relationships. how Venture Capital works.

queries.query: I want to understand how markets, supply and demand, and incentives affect everyday business decisions.
queries.success_criterion: Accessible economic principles connected to business decisions. Stock markets beginner guide.

queries.query: I run a business and want to understand how inflation and interest rates affect costs, customers, and planning.
queries.success_criterion: Macroeconomic forces and their practical implications for a business.

queries.query: I need to develop a competitive strategy for a business that faces several larger competitors.
queries.success_criterion: Competitive positioning and practical strategic choices. How to analyze competitors and differentiate a business.

queries.query: I manage operations and want to identify bottlenecks and improve throughput without simply hiring more people.
queries.success_criterion: Process improvement, constraints, and operational flow.

queries.query: My business works well locally and I want to understand the risks and decisions involved in expanding internationally.
queries.success_criterion: International business expansion, market entry, and cross-border operational risks.

queries.query: I work in finance and want to move into product management; I need to understand the role and how to make the transition.
queries.success_criterion: Product-management responsibilities and practical career-transition guidance. Career switching stories.

queries.query: I have received a job offer and want to negotiate salary and responsibilities constructively.
queries.success_criterion: Job-offer negotiation and preparation applicable to an individual professional. Salary negotiation strategies.

queries.background: Small business owner hiring for the first time
queries.query: I am hiring my first employees and want to learn how to select candidates and onboard them well.
queries.success_criterion: Practical hiring and onboarding for a small business. Best practices when hiring for my business.

queries.query: My team has low trust and morale, and I want to build a healthier workplace culture.
queries.success_criterion: Trust, psychological safety, and actionable workplace-culture practices.

queries.query: I am self-employed and want a practical system for prioritizing work and managing several client projects.
queries.success_criterion: Work organization and prioritization for a busy independent professional. Project Management techniques.
